last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 fresh menopause self-management topics, all classified as non-prescription candidates. The final query set returned 169 unique PubMed PMIDs, 169 fetched article records, and 169 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects were verified for PMID records: 23899828, 36283059, 21372745, 34526745, 42084929, 34931313, 19907348, 30125529, 37743153, 21900849, 19034052, 23982113, 16782922, 17664882, and 38669625. Fifteen PubMed references were added across 15 new entries. New entries cover aerobic exercise, resistance exercise, mindfulness, menopausal insomnia cognitive behavioral therapy, internet cognitive behavioral therapy, acupuncture, electroacupuncture, aromatherapy massage, flaxseed, omega-3, black cohosh, vitamin E, and mind-body exercise. The yoga, paced-breathing, hypnosis, sleep, weight-loss, soy-isoflavone, red-clover, evening-primrose, omega-3, vitamin-E, maca, black-cohosh, and acupuncture topics were linked to existing menopause evidence entries where applicable. Tai chi, qigong, stress management, relaxation, acupressure, Mediterranean diet, vitamin D, magnesium, and calcium were screened out because the selected PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control magnitude or valid relative effect. One truthful thin-study warning remains for the 43-person menopausal insomnia CBT pilot, in addition to the prior thin-study backlog.
